name: Health guard
summary: At the 5th round of the stage, then every 3 rounds, an agent judges whether further rounds still improve the work. When the marginal gain is too small (or the judgement fails), the run is paused.

config.user_prompt:
You review an iterative process that improves a piece of work round by round (a draft, a design, code, an answer). The work and its recent rounds are given to you as inputs or through your tools.

Judge whether further rounds still improve the quality enough to be worth their cost. Compare the latest round with the ones before it: what got better, what got worse, what only changed. Small rewordings, reshuffled structure and fixes that undo earlier fixes are not improvements. Count only gains a careful reader would notice.

Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"gain": <a number from 0 to 1: how much the latest round improved the work; 0 = no real improvement, 1 = a large improvement>, "improving": <true or false>, "reason": "<one or two sentences: the main gain or why there is none>"}

config.code:
import json
import re

# The judgement of the agent node before this one: its output is text that holds one JSON object.
# (Code nodes read the run context from context.json; their text is never interpolated.)
context = json.load(open("context.json"))
text = context["nodes"].get("Judge_progress", {}).get("output", "")
found = re.search(r"\{.*\}", text, re.S)
verdict = json.loads(found.group(0)) if found else {}
gain = float(verdict.get("gain", 0) or 0)
# The marginal gain below which more rounds are not worth it: change it to suit the work.
MIN_GAIN = 0.05
# The declared result field (Sets variables: gain); ok = the gain is still worth another round.
print(json.dumps({"ok": gain >= MIN_GAIN, "vars": {"gain": gain}, "reason": verdict.get("reason", "")}))
